new_results.statement: For Z_k(B)=e_k(B^T B)>0 and any rank-one physical update B+theta a b^T, the full k-minor vector is D_k(B)+theta C_k(B;a,b), hence Z_k(B+theta ab^T)=||D+theta C||_2^2 and inf_theta Z_k=eta^2 Z_k(B), where eta is the sine of the angle between D and C. Thus eta>0 prevents rank-k collapse for every sign and magnitude of theta.

When rank(B)=k and B=U Sigma V^T, Z_k(B+theta ab^T)=(det Sigma)^2[1+2 theta tau+theta^2 R], with tau=beta^T Sigma^{-1} alpha and R-tau^2 the explicit sum of left-, right-, and two-sided transverse repair energies.

concrete_application.description: Starting from partner B_c with s_5=2, four further mutually orthogonal spectral modes v_r=(e_{h_r}+e_{j_{4+r}})/sqrt(2) with arbitrary real eigenvalues preserve s_5>=2 exactly because B_c^T E_lambda=0. After a low signed packet of norm 1/64 and a further tail with cross norm 1/64, s_5(A[H,J])>=63/32.
concrete_application.density_regularization: continuous C_0 on this D5 branch

unresolved_implication: Derive, from bare s_3(A)>=1, either a quantitative original-coordinate fifth-volume carrier or a cancellation-aware exit to an already-paid grouped-bank/hub, pair, Schur, ridge, half-Riesz, common-plane, or related branch. Bi-independent spectral modes alone are insufficient because aggregate cross volume can cancel.
